title: No edge to vertices below two
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols, bit string $x$, and nonnegative integers $s,u,v$ with $v<2$, there is no edge from vertex $0$ to vertex $v$ for input $x$ and radius $s$.
